zh.title: 沙烏地批准達曼新低成本航空 目標2030年載客千萬
zh.summary: 沙烏地民航總署核發許可證；Air Arabia Alliance營運
body: 沙烏地阿拉伯民航總局（GACA）已核發許可，批准一家以達曼為基地的新國營低成本航空公司（LCC）。據報導，該監管機構於9月14日星期一向這家新航空公司核發營運許可證（AOC），此前該公司已完成安全、保安和營運品質方面的必要檢查。
這家新航空公司的營運名稱為Air Arabia Alliance，於2025年在GACA舉辦公開競爭後宣布成立。根據GACA的資料，此次競爭吸引了多家低成本航空公司的投標，Air Arabia Alliance被認為提出了最具競爭力的報價。這家新航空公司將從法赫德國王國際機場（DMM）營運國內和國際航班。
Air Arabia財團由總部位於沙迦的低成本航空公司Air Arabia，以及沙烏地投資者Kun Investment Holding和Nesma Group組成。「透過我們以價值為導向的商業模式，目標是加強沙烏地王國，特別是東部省的空中連通性，」Air Arabia集團執行長Adel Al Ali表示。
報導指出，該新航空公司最初將從其位在達曼的基地提供每天兩班飛往吉達和利雅德的航班，而飛往麥地那的航班則每天一班。該航空公司最終的目標是24個國內和57個國際目的地，每年透過達曼的主要國際門戶連接近1,000萬名乘客。
根據文章，新航空公司也期望營運空中巴士A320家族噴射客機，目標是擁有最多45架飛機，此資訊依根據ch-aviation的資料。文章也提到，這家航空公司的成立與沙地阿拉伯的2030願景（Vision 2030）規劃一致。

en.title: Saudi Arabia approves new low-cost carrier Air Arabia Alliance based in Dammam
body: Saudi Arabia's General Authority of Civil Aviation (GACA) has granted approval for a new national low-cost carrier (LCC) based in Dammam in the country's Eastern Region. The regulator issued an Air Operator Certificate (AOC) to the new carrier on Monday, September 14, after it completed required checks on safety, security, and operational quality.

The working name of the new budget carrier is Air Arabia Alliance, announced in 2025 after GACA concluded a public competition to launch a new LCC. According to GACA, the competition attracted bids from several LCCs, with Air Arabia Alliance credited with having placed the most competitive offer. The new airline will operate domestic and international flights from King Fahd International Airport (DMM).

The Air Arabia consortium comprises Sharjah-based low-cost carrier Air Arabia, along with Saudi investors Kun Investment Holding and Nesma Group. "Through our value-driven business model, we aim to enhance air connectivity across the UK, particularly in the Eastern Province," said Adel Al Ali, Air Arabia Group CEO.

Initially, the new airline will operate twice-daily flights from its home base in Dammam to Jeddah and Riyadh, while flights to Madinah will run daily. Ultimately, the airline is targeting 24 domestic and 57 international destinations, connecting nearly 10 million passengers annually through Dammam's main international gateway.

With Air Arabia operating an all-Airbus fleet, the new LCC is also expected to operate Airbus A320-family jets, with ambitions to feature up to 45 aircraft, according to ch-aviation. The launch of the carrier in the Eastern Region aligns with the Kingdom's National Transport and Logistics Strategy under Vision 2030.
en.summary: Saudi GACA issues AOC to budget carrier Air Arabia Alliance to operate from Dammam.
